text:
Six to eight months after the Battle of Odessen, the Commander, a veteran of the Galactic War, leads the Alliance in a battle against Empress Vaylin as she begins her conquest of the galaxy. Facing some of the biggest threats they have ever encountered, the Outlander and their Alliance discover new worlds and undertake dangerous undercover missions in their fight to take control of the Eternal Throne.

Chapter II: Run for the Shadows

text: The Eternal Alliance, ruled by the Alliance Commander, has overthrown the Eternal Empire by claiming the Eternal Throne and defeating The Immortal Emperor. Now as de-facto ruler of the galaxy, the Commander attempts to claim the world of Iokath in hopes of claiming its superweapons only to uncover that both the Sith Empire and Galactic Republic are also attempting to achieve the same objective. With galactic war brewing on the horizon, a traitorous conspiracy has been revealed that threatens to alter the galaxy yet again.
title: Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne — The War for Iokath

text: With the threat of a traitor within the Eternal Alliance after an attempt on the Alliance Commander, tensions have been high as the mole hunt continues. Lana Beniko has revealed to the Commander and Theron Shan of the traitor's location on Umbara trying to accumulate a source of adegan crystals. The trio heads to Umbara to apprehend the traitor and uncover their plan.

text: Theron Shan is the traitor! The Alliance Commander has placed locating Theron at the highest priority, Aristocra Saganu of the Chiss Ascendancy has arrived on Odessen revealing Theron's location on the Chiss world of Copero and reveals his intent to apprehend both Theron and the Chiss traitors who shelter him while Theron attempts to locate a Chiss secret to help him topple the Alliance.

text: The Alliance learns that Theron Shan has joined the Order of Zildrog to aid them in destroying the Alliance completely while receiving encoded transmissions from an unknown source on the Order's movement. Lana and the Commander learn that Theron is the one sending the Alliance information as well as the Order's objective to awaken Zildrog on Nathema. No time to piece together, Lana and the Commander race to Nathema to stop the Order and deal with Theron Shan for the sake of the galaxy.

text: The Eternal Alliance has faced a devastating blow after the mission to Nathema, which led to the destruction of both the Eternal Fleet and the Gravestone. Now with the threats removed, the galactic war between the Empire and Republic looms with the Empire conducting an assault on the Jedi world of Ossus, to which most of the Jedi, including Jedi Master and Council member Gnost-Dural, fled after Zakuul's Conquest of the galaxy. The Alliance Commander plays an important role in deciding which faction to support, which will ultimately have consequences in the overall conflict.
title: Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne — Jedi Under Siege

text: Sometime after the Invasion of Ziost, a Republic-Imperial joint task force led by Darth Marr is ambushed by the Eternal Empire during their search for the Sith Emperor in Wild Space. After learning that the ruler of the new empire is none other than the former Sith Emperor, now calling himself Valkorion, Darth Marr is executed. Through the machinations of Valkorion's son, Prince Arcann, Valkorion is killed, the player, now referred to as the Outlander, is imprisoned as Valkorion's murderer, and the newly crowned Emperor Arcann vows revenge against the galaxy.

text: The Outlander, frozen in an imperfect form of carbon freezing, meets with Valkorion in a dream sequence where Valkorion discusses the Outlander, the current state of the galaxy and how Zakuul is the only future of the galaxy.

text: Lana Beniko rescues the Outlander from the carbonite prison with the help of T7-O1 and Koth Vortena while evading Arcann's forces consisting of Skytroopers, Zakuul Knights and Vaylin, Arcann's sister and the Zakuul's High Justice. The trio manage to hijack a ship which is severely damaged by Vaylin but they manage to escape into the swamps of Zakuul.

text: The group crash lands in the Endless Swamp of Zakuul, where they locate an ancient alien frigate that can stand against the Eternal Fleet known only in legends as The Gravestone. While repairing the ship, Lana Beniko updates the Outlander on the state of the galaxy while Koth informs on his motivations to defect from Zakuul.

text: The Outlander learns that Valkorion now lives within their mind and promises his help in critical situations. The Eternal Empire attacks the group who manage to hold their ground until they are joined by Senya Tirall, a rogue Zakuul Knight who has a bitter history with Koth. Koth manages to repair the Gravestone and are able to destroy a sizeable portion of the Eternal Fleet with the Gravestone's omnicannon and swiftly escape Zakuul. Arcann witnesses that the Gravestone is now a considerable threat to his rule and orders Vaylin to hunt them down.

As it is revealed that Valkorion survived in the Outlander's mind, Senya reveals to that she is the mother of Arcann and Vaylin.

text: Koth is reluctant of Senya's desire to defeat her children while the group is informed of a potential ally on Zakuul known as the Lady of Sorrows, a notorious criminal with a reputation for murder and evading the Zakuul Knights, who claims that she can communicate with the Gravestone. Senya and the Outlander venture to Zakuul's underworld to meet with the Lady while confronting the Heralds of Zildrog.

section: Chapter XII: Visions in the Dark
text: While the Alliance dispatches Kaliyo Djannis and Havoc Squad to inflitrate the Spire and potentially cripple the Eternal Fleet, the Commander heads out to the wilderness of Odessen to consult with Valkorion only to be met with Valkorion's fury against the Outlander for failing to move beyond the boundaries of their former life. The Outlander is forced to face Valkorion's tests in order to grow strong enough to defeat Arcann and Vaylin as well as claim the Eternal Throne.

section: Chapter XVI: The Battle of Odessen
text: SCORPIO has betrayed the Alliance and seized control of the Eternal Throne. Meanwhile on Odessen, the Alliance faces an invasion from Emperor Arcann and his portion of the Eternal Fleet. The Alliance takes the fight to Arcann by boarding his flagship in order to allow the Alliance Commander to defeat the Eternal Emperor once and for all.
